verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any workflow-level throttling, concurrency limit, or execution queue that a developer could configure to respect downstream rate limits. Automatic retries are a related error-handling feature, not throttling. The community note about a 10 req/s rate limit describes a platform-imposed ingress cap, not a user-configurable control. Custom Node.js code is only a building block for constructing throttling yourself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can throttle or queue workflow executions to respect downstream rate limits
